Question: ASAK Mufti Saheb - My daughter is married with 1 male child, my son-in-law has taken her to KSA without our permission, he is not allowing her to speaking to parents and whenever we call he does not answers or pass the line to her. Also we understand he says she must not take parents name in front of the child if the child says our name with love and affection will receiving bashing. Does not like to clarify any thing to us. However the husband and wife are happy we are worried as to what is wrong on our side. Some say the son-in-law family (bhabhi and sisters) have done some jaddo tonna on him not to listen or turn to our side. Please advise us what to do and any ziker which can turn his heart kind and speak to us and things go ok. Answer ID: 20583 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 411/335/B=1431) You should not be obsessed with the doubt magic and witchcraft. After Isha salah in the state of wudhu recite ya Aziz ( يا عزيز ) two hundred times with durood 3-3 times before and after by turning your face towards the house of your son-in-law. In-shaAllah it will soften his heart. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
